Title: Axis Ops portal login with static OTP
Story: As an operations user I want to sign in to the Axis Ops portal at /login. On the sign-in screen (heading Welcome to our portal), I enter my username in the Username field and my password in the Password field, then click the Sign in button. The app shows the Verification Code screen (Enter the OTP you just received on your registered number and e-mail). I enter the lab static OTP 245345 in the OTP field, click the Verify OTP button, and I must be logged in: the Verification Code screen and OTP field must not be shown anymore, and the Dashboard must show Welcome! with Start navigating through the portal. Use exact labels: Username, Password, Sign in, OTP field, Verify OTP.
